transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been going on that brought you in today?

I came in because… well, I know the people at my apartment are watching when I leave and when I come back. And I think they’re slipping notes about me to the office. Everybody keeps saying it’s just regular notices on the doors, but it doesn’t feel like that to me.
Have you ever felt like you’re seeing, hearing, or sensing something that others don’t seem to notice?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed seeing or hearing things like that, not in a clear way. It’s more just… I get the feeling something’s going on, but I don’t know if that’s what you mean.
Have you ever had thoughts that others might not believe or seem strange to people, like believing something is happening that isn't, or that people are involved in things they don't think they are?

Yes… I mean, I know it probably sounds strange to other people, but I really do believe the people at my apartment are keeping track of when I leave and come back. And I think they’re slipping notes about me to the office. Everybody keeps saying those are just regular notices on the doors, but it doesn’t feel that way to me.
Do you ever question whether these beliefs about the people in your apartment and the notes might not be true, or do you feel completely certain they are true no matter what others say?

I mean… people tell me it’s just regular notices on the doors, but I don’t really believe that. It feels pretty clear to me that they’re watching when I leave and come back, and that those notes are about me getting reported to the office. So no, I don’t really question it much.
Have these feelings or beliefs about being watched and the notes being about you been happening almost every day for the past month, or do they come and go?
It’s been pretty much there most days. It’s not just once in a while. I’d say it’s been going on for about a year… maybe a year and a month now.
Have you ever experienced any sensations, like seeing, hearing, or feeling something that others around you don’t seem to notice?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t really seen or heard things that other people don’t notice. It’s more just what I think is going on around me.
